# RepForge

> Free-first fitness and bodybuilding web app for adults 18+. Founded by Idowu Elijah Oluwasegun (IDOWU ELIJAH OLUWASEGUN) in Nigeria.

## Site
- Homepage: https://oluwasegun-reforge.vercel.app/
- Exercises: https://oluwasegun-reforge.vercel.app/exercises
- Workouts: https://oluwasegun-reforge.vercel.app/workouts
- Nutrition (Nigeria): https://oluwasegun-reforge.vercel.app/nutrition
- Timer: https://oluwasegun-reforge.vercel.app/workouts/timer
- Beginners: https://oluwasegun-reforge.vercel.app/beginners
- Founder section: https://oluwasegun-reforge.vercel.app/#founder

## Founder
- Name: Idowu Elijah Oluwasegun
- Formal: IDOWU ELIJAH OLUWASEGUN
- Role: Founder of RepForge
- Location: Lagos, Nigeria

## Benefits
- Clear exercise demos for home or gym
- Workout plans that fit available time and equipment
- Nigerian nutrition guidance with local plates
- Real day-by-day progress from completed sessions
- Spoken coach timer reminders
- Free-first access (guest browse + signed-in dashboard)

## Audience / Geo
- Primary: adults 18+ in Nigeria (Lagos and nationwide)
- Also useful worldwide for English-speaking beginners and intermediates
